question: What physical form must a suitable ritual tree possess from root to tip?
premises: round-shaped form extends root to tip
inference: A suitable tree is round-shaped, many-branched, and firm-elongated from root to tip.
uncertainties: internal sandhi of vṛttākārastu is not expanded into separate rows
plain_english: It is round-shaped, from root to tip many-branched and firm-elongated.
